title: Retail Sales Performance Report: 2023–2024
executive_summary: Across 520 orders, the business generated $445,325 in total revenue over the 2023–2024 period, with a year-over-year revenue increase of approximately 10.1%. The East region led all regions in revenue. A data issue caused all 2024 quarterly revenue figures to return zero, preventing quarterly trend analysis. High-discount electronics represent a notable revenue segment, and customer concentration is moderate with the top customer accounting for 6.2% of total revenue.

key_findings.statement: The dataset contains 520 orders generating total revenue of $445,325.09, with an average order value of $856.39.
The East region led with $130,516.69 in revenue, followed by North ($124,845.75), West ($99,428.16), and South ($90,534.49). East outpaced South by $39,982.20.

All four 2024 quarterly revenue figures (Q1–Q4) returned $0.00 due to a data processing failure. No valid quarterly trend can be reported; this requires investigation into the date parsing or data coverage for 2024.
Revenue grew from $211,976.29 in 2023 to $233,348.80 in 2024, a year-over-year increase of approximately 10.1%.
There are 22 Electronics orders with a discount of 20% or more, generating $50,035.33 in combined revenue.

Order revenue is highly right-skewed: the mean is $856.39 but the median is only $313.28, with a standard deviation of $1,295.74. Values range from $5.27 to $7,844.02, indicating a small number of very large orders pulling the average upward.
There are 222 unique customers. The highest-revenue customer contributed $27,793.13, representing 6.2% of total revenue, indicating moderate but notable concentration at the top.

limitations: Both the cleaning and analysis pipeline stages reported validation failures; all findings should be treated as provisional until the pipeline is re-run on validated data.
All 2024 quarterly revenue values are zero, indicating a likely date-parsing or data-coverage error in the analysis stage; the quarterly trend analysis is therefore unreliable.
The contradiction between non-zero revenue_2024 ($233,348.80) and zero quarterly 2024 revenues suggests a date format inconsistency that was not resolved during cleaning.
The cleaning stage failure may mean that duplicate records, outliers, or missing values were not fully addressed, potentially affecting all aggregated metrics.
No product-level or margin data is available, so revenue figures cannot be translated into profitability insights.
conclusion: Despite pipeline validation failures, the data indicates positive overall momentum: 520 orders, $445,325 in total revenue, and approximately 10.1% year-over-year growth from 2023 to 2024. The East region leads in revenue, and order values are highly skewed, suggesting a long tail of small orders alongside a few high-value transactions. The 2024 quarterly trend is unresolvable due to a data error and must be re-investigated. Stakeholders should treat these figures as directional until a clean, validated pipeline run is completed.
